verdict.rationale: Evidence shows n8n has a general API (n8n-docs-16), a credentials system for storing third-party service secrets (n8n-docs-23), and role-based access/audit trails for users (n8n-gh-5), but nothing describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials specifically for an AI agent to act on n8n's behalf. The credentials and RBAC features shown are for human users and workflow nodes, not agent-scoped API key issuance.
